data_inventory.decision: 원본 파일은 해시와 공급기관 인코딩을 유지한다. 새 다운로드만 표준 명명 규칙을 적용하고, 표준화 파일은 UTF-8-SIG로 별도 저장한다.

feature_contract.energy_source_filter: not applied in the nationwide model-ready table; each model job selects its technology

quality_policy.negative_generation: invalid; preserve flag and exclude from training, never replace with zero
quality_policy.contextual_anomalies: flag only; do not automatically impute or delete
quality_policy.invalid_weather: set missing with reason flag; impute from training data only

weather_availability.policy: retain generation in Silver but withhold it from Gold until the matching official KMA annual file is present
